root_cause_criterion.criterion: Immediately after subtracting the real block-parameter width, `wasm_loader_prepare_bytecode` must keep `loader_ctx->frame_offset` at or above `loader_ctx->frame_offset_bottom` before later block-parameter forwarding can proceed.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable fast-interpreter block-parameter path subtracts the parsed parameter width from `loader_ctx->frame_offset` even when only a one-cell `VALUE_TYPE_ANY` placeholder was popped. In the crashing run this moves the pointer below `loader_ctx->frame_offset_bottom`, and only the fixed program's new lower-bound check prevents the later dummy offset write from using that underflowed state.

nodes.state: After the first available block parameter is passed back into the new block, `loader_ctx->frame_offset` has moved upward but still remains below `loader_ctx->frame_offset_bottom`.
At the dummy block-parameter write sink, the first `*loader_ctx->frame_offset++ = 0` store starts from a pointer that is still below `loader_ctx->frame_offset_bottom`.

edges.relation: The later available-parameter forwarding step mutates the same underflowed `loader_ctx->frame_offset` pointer upward from the step-8 underflow position, but not back into bounds.
The adjusted `loader_ctx->frame_offset` value is carried unchanged into the subsequent dummy-parameter zero-write loop.
